translated_title_controls.input: DXIL produced by TuxBox for Frosty. All shader table calls returned S_OK with successful IDxcOperationResult status on both DLLs.

miss.check: After patching, disassembly of the entire entry function matched between providers.

ray_generation.check: Bound the reflected resources through a global root signature containing 128 descriptors of each range type in spaces 0 and 1. Collected compiled library blobs from both providers. The outputs target different resource-binding implementations.

desktop_gpu_control.shader: [shader("raygeneration")] void WriteRay() { uint i = DispatchRaysIndex().x; output.Store(i * 4, 0xf1e00000u ^ i); }
cases: Global root UAV set before dispatch
Local root UAV supplied as a GPU VA at byte 32 of the ray-generation shader record
desktop_gpu_control.reference_comparison: The Xbox control lowered the global and local binding to platform-specific loads feeding a DXIL rawBufferStore. The GPU dispatch used only the TuxBox output.

remaining: General continuation compilation (ray suspension, traversal and stages beyond scalar payload-only misses), and the console GPU scheduler linker (slot 9).
Xbox-specific compiler intrinsics, alternate root or shader-record layouts, and resource classes outside the supported binding paths.
These checks ran without launching Frosty and do not establish frame rendering or title-wide parity.

continuation_cross_link.method: Both slot 8 implementations received the Frosty miss shader, the Series driver runtime callback, its traversal library and its scheduling library. The original slot 9 linked each resulting collection in isolation. The control checked the -1.0f payload write in the final compute shader state function.
continuation_cross_link.constraint: The Series scheduler generated by slot 9 converts a 32-bit state identifier to a GPU function pointer (llvm.xbox.pointer.32), makes an indirect cc804 call, and reads absolute GPU addresses. Desktop state objects return opaque shader identifiers. The cross-link control stops at final compute DXIL. It does not execute the console scheduler on a desktop device.
